basic_details.short_information: Two Doctor posts on contract are open at NFL Hospital, Bathinda, with National Fertilizers Limited (NFL), a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Fertilizers & Chemicals, through its Bathinda Unit. Applications in the prescribed proforma go by email to [email protected]. The last date for receipt of the duly filled application is 31 December 2026, unless NFL extends it and notifies the extension on its website.

qualification.details: NFL is engaging two (02) Doctors. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. | Qualification: MBBS with minimum 02 years post qualification experience after internship in a hospital of repute. Any other higher qualification or diploma in medical discipline after MBBS will be given preference. OR: MD/DNB in medicine/Obs. & Gyn after internship in a hospital of repute. Recognition: the degree of MBBS/MD/DNB must be recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI), along with a valid registration certificate. Nationality: the candidate must be an Indian national possessing the requisite qualification from a University/Institute recognised by the Medical Council of India. Age limit: maximum 62 years as on 30.11.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Cut-off date: 30.11.2026 is the cut-off date for reckoning eligibility for all purposes. Pay: fixed contractual amount of Rs.75,000/- per month (Rs.2884.62/- x 26 working days) for one year, with a 10% annual increase if the engagement is extended. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Doctor post.

selection_process: Selection for the NFL Doctor posts is by shortlisting followed by a personal interview.
Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be provisionally shortlisted on the basis of the documents enclosed with the application form

Selection is made according to merit drawn from the performance of shortlisted candidates in the interview. A candidate must obtain a minimum of 50% marks in the personal interview to be selected. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Joining is subject to medical fitness.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary, for an initial period of one year. It may be extended yearly on requirement/performance, but will not exceed 03 years in any case. Suitable Company accommodation (B-Type) in NFL Township may be provided, if required, on payment of normal licence fee at par with NFL employees as per company's rule; water and electricity are charged as for NFL employees. Casual leave is one day per month on pro-rata basis (maximum 12 days in the one-year contract), in addition to weekly offs and closed holidays (GH+NH). Excess leave is deducted proportionately from the monthly payment, and no half-day leave is given. The Doctor must arrange his/her own travel to NFL Hospital (no transport is provided) and obtain insurance coverage for self for the period of engagement. Either side may end the contract with one month's prior notice or one month's pay (Rs.75,000/-) in lieu. NFL reserves the right to terminate without notice if performance or conduct is not satisfactory, and absence from duty without permission is liable for termination. The contract appointee must sign a contract agreement with NFL on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.100/- (attested by a Notary Public) within ten days of starting work, at his/her own cost. Income Tax is deducted at source from the monthly payment. NFL is under no obligation to give a regular appointment or preference for any vacancy. Incomplete or unsigned applications, applications not in the prescribed proforma, without self-attested documents, not meeting eligibility, sent to another NFL email id or received after the due date will be summarily rejected. NFL reserves the right to reject any application, cancel the process or admit less than the number of doctors indicated. Civil Court Bathinda has exclusive jurisdiction in any dispute.

content_sections.heading: About NFL Doctor
content_sections.text: National Fertilizers Limited is a Navratna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Fertilizers & Chemicals. This engagement is conducted by its Bathinda Unit (Human Resources Department) in Punjab, and the selected Doctors will work at NFL Hospital, Bathinda, with emergency duty at the hospital or plant when required.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent by email only to [email protected] . An application received at any other email id of NFL will be rejected. The last date for receipt is 31 December 2026, unless extended and notified on NFL's website.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: NFL is engaging two (02) Doctors. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts. Qualification: MBBS with minimum 02 years post qualification experience after internship in a hospital of repute. Any other higher qualification or diploma in medical discipline after MBBS will be given preference. OR: MD/DNB in medicine/Obs. & Gyn after internship in a hospital of repute. Recognition: the degree of MBBS/MD/DNB must be recognised by the Medical Council of India (MCI), along with a valid registration certificate. Nationality: the candidate must be an Indian national possessing the requisite qualification from a University/Institute recognised by the Medical Council of India. Age limit: maximum 62 years as on 30.11.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Cut-off date: 30.11.2026 is the cut-off date for reckoning eligibility for all purposes. Pay: fixed contractual amount of Rs.75,000/- per month (Rs.2884.62/- x 26 working days) for one year, with a 10% annual increase if the engagement is extended. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Doctor post.

content_sections.heading: NFL Doctor Job Description
content_sections.text: Full time duty as Doctor at NFL Hospital, Bathinda. Morning OPD from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM and evening OPD from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM on all working days. Attend NFL Hospital during regular OPD hours in person; a representative may not be deputed in any case. Attend emergency duties as, when and where (NFL Hospital/plant) required. For full duty performed on a weekly off, NH or GH, compensation is paid on a proportionate basis.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: With the emailed application, the notice asks for self-attested copies of the certificates of date of birth, educational qualifications and post qualification work experience, and the Relieving Order from the last employer (if not presently employed). The general conditions list these certificates and documents, in original with one set of self-attested photocopies, for the interview: Filled-in application format (Annexure-A) with one recent passport size coloured photograph Proof of date of birth – SSLC / Matriculation Certificate All educational certificates and mark sheets from Class X onwards Valid registration certificate issued by the Medical Council of India Experience certificate showing relevant post qualification experience; retired employees must give the service certificate issued by the parent organisation Photo identity proof (EPIC / PAN card / Aadhaar Card / Passport / Driving License) Certificates are verified during the interview, and a candidate who fails to produce them will not be allowed to appear in the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the NFL Doctor posts is by shortlisting followed by a personal interview. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be provisionally shortlisted on the basis of the documents enclosed with the application form, and called for interview. Selection is made according to merit drawn from the performance of shortlisted candidates in the interview. A candidate must obtain a minimum of 50% marks in the personal interview to be selected. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Joining is subject to medical fitness.
